name: esgames-plugins
description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: journal
plugins.description: Conversational journaling assistant that interviews you about your day and saves a Markdown entry to documents/journal/

plugins.name: usability-report
plugins.description: Evaluates a target (URL, app, UI, or codebase) against Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics and generates a structured Markdown report with severity ratings and recommendations.

plugins.name: prioritize
plugins.description: Pull-by-energy work picker. Reads In Progress and Ready cards from Linear and suggests ones that match your current energy.

plugins.name: introspection
plugins.description: Reflective conversation partner that loads your journal history and Linear board to surface work patterns, stalled tasks, and recurring themes.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Iterative research assistant that dispatches subagents for broad overviews then user-directed deep dives, keeping the main context clean.

plugins.name: context-snapshot
plugins.description: Rebuilds current_context.md from all available artifacts — journal entries, Linear board, usability reports, and research notes. Run after a break or when context has drifted.

plugins.name: one-on-one
plugins.description: Manage one-on-one conversation threads — capture topics to discuss with specific people and review them before each meeting.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Generates a concise morning standup report (Yesterday / Today / Blockers) from your journal entries and Linear board.

plugins.name: spirograph
plugins.description: Design and generate ESG spirograph animation scripts — interview-driven script generation using gear mechanics, color palettes, and pattern ratios.

plugins.name: firefly
plugins.description: Generate optimized Adobe Firefly image prompts — interview-driven prompt builder covering subject, style, lighting, composition, and mood.

plugins.name: ideate
plugins.description: Brainstorm ideas on a topic with subagents, have three diverse topic-specific personas score them, and present the list ranked by normalized score.
